verdict.rationale: Sift documents a Review Queues product alongside Workflows for real-time decisioning, and community evidence confirms customers use human review with a go/no-go decision on flagged users, supporting the review-queue workflow. However, no evidence details what the review queue UI actually displays — customer history, signal breakdowns, or similar/related case linking — so the 'full context' aspect of the story is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: documentation or screenshots of the review queue UI showing customer history, signal context, and similar-case surfacing.
